pub enum ProcessTurnState {
    Queued {
        accepted_input: signalbox_domain::AcceptedInputId,
        content: signalbox_domain::UserContent,
    },
    QueuedDelegated {
        spawning_request: signalbox_domain::ToolRequestId,
        parent_session: signalbox_domain::SessionId,
        parent_turn: signalbox_domain::TurnId,
        content: string::String,
    },
    QueuedDelegationWake {
        first_delivery_sequence: u64,
        through_delivery_sequence: u64,
    },
    DelegationTerminated {
        spawning_request: signalbox_domain::ToolRequestId,
        outcome: outbox::DispatchedDelegationOutcome,
        reason: outbox::DispatchedDelegationReason,
        provenance: outbox::DispatchedDelegationProvenance,
    },
    ActiveRunning {
        current_attempt: signalbox_domain::TurnAttemptId,
        current_model_call: option::Option<process_read::ProcessCurrentModelCall>,
    },
    ActiveAwaitingModelCallRecovery {
        ended_attempt: signalbox_domain::TurnAttemptId,
        recovery_call: signalbox_domain::ModelCallId,
        automatic_reconciliation_attempts: u32,
        operator_action_required: bool,
    },
    ActiveAwaitingToolApproval {
        request: signalbox_domain::ToolRequestId,
    },
    ActiveAwaitingChild {
        awaiting_request: signalbox_domain::ToolRequestId,
        spawning_request: signalbox_domain::ToolRequestId,
        child: signalbox_domain::SessionId,
    },
    ActiveAwaitingToolRecovery {
        ended_attempt: signalbox_domain::TurnAttemptId,
        recovery_attempt: signalbox_domain::ToolAttemptId,
        automatic_reconciliation_attempts: u32,
        operator_action_required: bool,
    },
    ActiveAwaitingRunnerRecovery {
        runner: signalbox_domain::RunnerId,
        placement_revision: signalbox_domain::RunnerGeneration,
        interrupted_tool_attempt: option::Option<signalbox_domain::ToolAttemptId>,
    },
    Failed {
        terminal_frontier: signalbox_domain::ContextFrontierId,
        terminal_attempt: option::Option<signalbox_domain::TurnAttemptId>,
        terminal_model_call: option::Option<process_read::ProcessFailedTerminalModelCall>,
    },
    Completed {
        terminal_frontier: signalbox_domain::ContextFrontierId,
        terminal_attempt: signalbox_domain::TurnAttemptId,
        terminal_call: signalbox_domain::ModelCallId,
    },
    Refused {
        terminal_frontier: signalbox_domain::ContextFrontierId,
        terminal_attempt: signalbox_domain::TurnAttemptId,
        terminal_call: signalbox_domain::ModelCallId,
    },
    Cancelled {
        terminal_frontier: signalbox_domain::ContextFrontierId,
        terminal_attempt: signalbox_domain::TurnAttemptId,
        terminal_call: option::Option<signalbox_domain::ModelCallId>,
    },
    ReconciliationRequired {
